newsitem.title: UK: Fred. Olsen wins Angola FPSO contract.
newsitem.headline: Fred. Olsen wins Angola FPSO contract.

text.p: A joint venture between Fred. Olsen Production AS, Oslo and Nortrans Engineering Group Pte. Ltd, Singapore, said Thursday it has won a contract from Ranger Oil Ltd for the lease and operation of a floating, production, storage and offloading (FPSO)vessel in the Kiame field, offshore Angola.
The venture has acquired the Suezmax tanker Knock Buie from First Olsen Tankers Ltd for conversion for the project, a statement from the Oslo Stock exchange said.
The Knock Buie is due to be converted this autumn at a shipyard, which has not yet been named.
The contract will last four years duration and has a value in the order of $50 million.
Production is due to start in the second quarter of 1998 and is expected to rise to a rate of 7,000 barrels of oil per day or more depending upon reservoir performance, Ranger Oil said.
Block 4 of the Kiame field has reserves of approximately 8 million barrels and lies in 140 meters of water.

The sale price of the Knock Buie will be about $9 million with special survey passed, First Olsen said. The 135,015 dwt vessel is scheduled to be delivered to the buyer in the Far East in the fourth quarter this year. -- Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087 Fax 5017
